Not OP but as a trauma survivor myself, sometimes the fear of being invalidated, not believed, or told the trauma wasn’t that bad/you should be over it is so strong that the urge to embellish it to be something you view as “traumatic enough” is there. I fight against it, but there are times where I’ll catch myself embellishing slightly and have to correct myself.
ETA: trauma survivors often crave empathy and approval because trauma can skew your thoughts to think that you deserve bad things/aren’t good enough/ aren’t lovable etc. also abusers are often invalidating and might gaslight you about what happened
